assets.purpose: Design an accessible, understated nutrient coverage experience that NEVER merges daily food-reporting completeness with per-nutrient data availability, reference eligibility, or individualized nutritional adequacy.

assets.scientificAccuracy: Reporting status describes what the user or reviewed canonical completion contract says was logged; source status describes which nutrient facts are quantified on recorded entries. Nutritional adequacy or excess is never inferred from a single day/target bar; separate eligibility requires representative usual intake, reference applicability, methods/uncertainty and individual context. Upper limits are safety boundaries with chemical form/source applicability, never goal bars. Missing, invalid, incomparable or withdrawn values remain unknown; source and diary corrections recalculate their independent states.
